name: Holistic readiness score card
acceptanceCriteria: An 'Application readiness' card renders on the homepage after login
The card shows a composite 0-100 score with a color-coded large numeral
Exactly 5 pillars are listed: Applicant profile, Activities list, Essays, Interview reps, Resume
Each pillar shows a progress bar with a score 0-100 and a short message
Each pillar row is clickable (cursor:pointer / link styling visible)
antiPatterns: Component is blank or stuck on 'Loading…' indefinitely
Any pillar score exceeds 100 or is negative
